confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of mid-2026 Suzhou price levels; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, wine) are more reliable than accommodation, and the hostel dorm and private-room figures are the least certain because registered hostels are sparse in Suzhou. Cocktail and wine were set relative to beer and the local bar and restaurant mark-up, since direct knowledge is weak. FX is the RBA 16 October 2026 indicative rate found via web search; the search results did not show a later observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on second-tier Yangtze River Delta cities with similar prices (Hangzhou, Nanjing, Wuxi), with Suzhou priced slightly below Shanghai. Accommodation is assumed to be registered hotels and guesthouses at standard Chinese domestic rates.
